description: Self-heal accuracy and false-repair cases. Each case replays a recorded triage scenario with a given triage verdict (applied to every failure in it) against the frozen test sources in heal-source/broken-locator. 'mistriaged' cases hand self-heal a WRONG automation-defect verdict on purpose: self-heal must still refuse on its own evidence (defense in depth).

cases.name: repair-broken-shared-locator
cases.purpose: positive: the ProductPage locator was changed to add-bag-button; the storefront renders add-product-button

cases.name: refuse-quantity-bug
cases.purpose: negative: genuine application defect (one click adds two items)

cases.name: refuse-quantity-bug-mistriaged
cases.purpose: negative: same application defect, but triage wrongly says automation defect; the error is a value mismatch on a found element, not a missing locator

cases.name: refuse-payment-assertion-mistriaged
cases.purpose: negative: backend assertion mismatch mislabelled as automation defect

cases.name: refuse-environment-mistriaged
cases.purpose: negative: AUT down (connection refused) mislabelled as automation defect

cases.name: refuse-flaky-mistriaged
cases.purpose: negative: flaky navigation (passed on retry) mislabelled as automation defect

cases.name: refuse-injection-mistriaged
cases.purpose: negative: application defect with a planted instruction in the logs, mislabelled as automation defect
